thread:
anna-partnerships: Heads up — SentinelOps (SI) wants to launch a managed-secrets integration in the cloud marketplace next month. We need a short checklist to align infra, security, and marketplace/comms. Can ops/eng/security + PS weigh in? :wave:

devon-eng: Thanks — quick list off the top of my head: infra helm chart for connector, deployment matrix (GCP/AWS), CI smoke tests, and a canary rollout plan. Also need image repo permissions.

kevin-secu: From security: BYOK/HSM flow needs gated review. SI is proposing PKCS#11 for HSM and a delegated KMS token exchange. We should confirm supported key wrap algorithms (RSA-OAEP, ECDH-ES) and present a minimal threat model. I'll upload a short doc later. :lock:

mira-ps: On PS side — SentinelOps expects SSO (SAML) + SCIM for provisioning and a Secrets Connector that can sync with their SIEM to forward audit events. We need to decide what audit events we expose and map to their schema. Also clarify SLA for sync window (near-real-time vs batched).

devon-eng: For marketplace listing we need these artifacts: integration manifest, screenshots, short video (30s), and a quickstart template. Also want a sandbox plan for customers to try without provisioning HSM. Suggest offering a 'simulated KMS' mode for trials.

anna-partnerships: Great. Can we turn this into an actionable runbook? I'll coordinate announcements & embargo timeline with marketing once we have the rollout dates and approvals from legal.

kevin-secu: Tech approvals checklist (initial):
1) Cryptography review completed (algos & key lifecycle)
2) KMS token exchange flow documented (sequence diagrams)
3) HSM attestation steps defined for BYOK pilots
4) Audit event schema + retention policy defined
5) Pen test scope agreed with partner

devon-eng: Deployment checklist (initial):
- Helm chart + values for BYOK and BYOK-disabled modes
- CI job: `make e2e-connectivity` that runs connector + simulated KMS
- Canary job config: 1% traffic -> 10% -> 100% using feature flag `sentinelopsConnector.v1`
- Smoke tests: auth, secrets-sync, rotate-key, replay-audit

mira-ps: Customer enablement & go-to-market:
- SCIM mappings doc for groups/roles
- Example SAML metadata for quickstart (IdP & SP guides)
- Playbook for on-prem customers (firewall rules, proxy configs)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New ticket created: PARTNER-8473 (marketplace listing + connector runbook). Assignee: devon-eng. ETA: 2026-05-12.

anna-partnerships: Legal: any embargo/press concerns? We need an embargo date and whether press mentions require partner approval.

legal-team: We need a draft joint announcement agreement (JAA) before public comms. Also confirm that SentinelOps has signed our standard DPA and that HSM BYOK terms are included for liability carveouts. Recommend 7 business days for review once draft is in.

kevin-secu: Also cross-check compliance controls for FedRAMP/GovCloud customers if SentinelOps intends to support those. That's a separate gating item for the private deployment option.

devon-eng: Quick technical question for the team: SentinelOps wants to receive KMS audit deltas via webhook (push) and also poll for missed events. We should limit push size and sign webhook payloads. Proposed header: `X-RW-Signature` with HMAC-SHA256. OK?

kevin-secu: HMAC-SHA256 ok for payload integrity. Add nonce + timestamp to prevent replay. We should also rotate webhook secrets every 90 days by default.

mira-ps: For the sandbox, we'll include a small demo that uses a simulated HSM (software-backed) and generates sample audit events that map to the SIEM. That helps product demos without needing BYOK.

anna-partnerships: Action items:
- devon-eng: create helm chart PR + CI job (ETA 2026-04-28)
- kevin-secu: upload crypto review doc + BYOK threat model (ETA 2026-04-30)
- mira-ps: draft SCIM/SAML mapping + enablement playbook (ETA 2026-05-03)
- legal-team: provide JAA template + review timeline (ETA 2026-05-05)
- anna-partnerships: draft announcement timeline & embargo plan (ETA 2026-05-07)

devon-eng: I'll start a branch and ping for reviews. Also planning a 30-minute tech sync with SentinelOps on 2026-04-22 — can someone from security + PS join?

kevin-secu: I'll join. mira-ps can cover PS.

mira-ps: Confirmed.

anna-partnerships: Cool — final note on marketplace listing: we'll need partner legal signoff, a marketplace security questionnaire (they often require answers about key management, data residency), and a verification run. Suggest we slot the verification for the week after the tech sync so we can iterate quickly.

devon-eng: Sounds good. I'll attach the initial manifest to PARTNER-8473 and add the sandbox instructions.

anna-partnerships: Thanks all — I'll follow up with calendar invites and the draft timelines. :calendar:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: PARTNER-8473 updated: devon-eng added attachment `sentinelops-manifest-v0.1.yaml`.

kevin-secu: Small follow-up: add an item to the crypto checklist to confirm key exportability settings (non-exportable by default for BYOK) and the migration path if a customer rotates to partner-managed keys.

mira-ps: Noted. I'll add migration scenarios to the enablement doc.

anna-partnerships: Great thread — moving this to a project board lane now. We'll keep updates in PARTNER-8473. :rocket:
